title: 阿卡丽·核心素描
description: 高马尾阿卡丽在石阶边沉稳低蹲，绿色面罩与深色忍装融入炭笔排线，标志镰刃静置身侧。

art_direction.medium: hand-drawn graphite and charcoal, confident pencil contours, cross-hatching, sculptural chiaroscuro and visible pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Akali is an adult Ionian ninja with a high dark ponytail, focused eyes, a green cloth face covering, and recognizable green-purple costume accents. Preserve her lean athletic adult proportions while fully covering her torso with a fitted long-sleeved ninja jacket, opaque trousers, wraps, gloves, and boots. Her curved kama hangs motionless beside the leg, and her kunai remains securely sheathed.
art_direction.scene: Use a slightly elevated viewpoint and an off-center composition, connecting the face and signature motif with a clear arc of pencil contours. Build the composition specifically around this champion's defining anatomy, iconic motif and explicitly listed companion, if any. Use one faint environmental cue belonging to this character, and leave the rest as open sketch paper.
art_direction.palette: deep jade, plum shadow, pale limestone, warm gold light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
